title: feat(platform-objects): Setup → Users on a managed environment offers Add User and Import Users through the pending-person doors

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:托管环境(`OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1`)的「设置 → 用户」重新出现两个按钮:「添加用户」(邮箱、姓名,可选岗位、权限集、上级邮箱)和「导入用户」(粘贴 CSV)。两者都走 #33227 新加的待激活用户接口,添加的人没有密码,首次通过组织的身份提供方登录。只有平台管理员看得到。
- 为什么改:#25309 为了「托管只走云端邀请」把加人的按钮全藏了;按 cloud#4465 的裁决,人员改为在环境里添加,#33227 已经提供了接口,但界面上还没有入口。
- 风险与回滚:只新增两个 `sys_user` 动作和它们的多语言文案;原来的「创建用户」「设置密码」和四个「邀请用户」在托管环境仍然隐藏,非托管环境什么都没变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts` 的 `MANAGED_ADD_PERSON_VISIBLE` 与 `add_sso_user` / `import_sso_users` 两段;`packages/platform-objects/src/feature-gate-guard.test.ts` 新增的 `SHOWN_WHEN_ON`(为什么不改 spec 见 Acceptance notes)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run src/identity/cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts`,预期全绿:托管时平台管理员只看到两个新按钮,非托管时只看到原来的六个。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

On a cloud-managed environment the password and invitation actions are hidden (`features.cloudManaged`, #25309), and since #33227 the environment has its own add-person doors, `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/add-sso-user` and `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/import-sso-users`. Nothing in Setup reached them. This PR adds their two first-party actions on `sys_user`:

- **`add_sso_user`** ("Add User", list toolbar, `type: 'api'`, target `admin/add-sso-user`). Params: `email` and `name` (field-backed), `positions` (`widget: 'position-ref'`), `permissionSets` (`widget: 'permission-ref'`), `manager` (`type: 'email'`). Each picker submits one name; the door reads a string as a list of one. The result dialog shows the address, and only when present on the answer: `notApplied` (a re-add of a person still pending), `managerError` and `host.reason` (the hosting organisation was not told).
- **`import_sso_users`** ("Import Users", list toolbar, target `admin/import-sso-users`). One `csv` param (`textarea`); the result dialog shows `summary.added` / `alreadyPending` / `failed` and the per-row answer as JSON. The row-by-row UI is #33187's.

Both are offered by `current_user.isPlatformAdmin == true && has(features.cloudManaged) && features.cloudManaged == true`:

- The standing is the door's own gate (`gateAdmin` → `judgePlatformAdmin`, ADR-0068 D4), and both declare `requiredPermissions: [...PLATFORM_ADMIN_USERS_GATE]` like every other door in that family. No `requiresFeature: 'admin'`: the doors mount without the better-auth admin plugin, which Free and Team kernels do not carry.
- `features.cloudManaged == true` is where the door answers; off it the door answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`.
- `has()` keeps both hidden while the console holds no served flag: an action `visible` that faults SHOWS the action (`RequiresFeatureSlot` docs in `public-auth-features.ts`), the trap `create_user`'s second email param already guards against.

No existing predicate is edited. `create_user`, `set_user_password`, the four `invite_user` mirrors and `copy_invitation_link` stay hidden on a managed environment.

**Measured first** (tree `a199be81` = `origin/main` `ee627c67` plus the two actions; the measuring script evaluates every identity action whose target is a person-adding, invitation or password door through `@objectstack/formula`'s `celEngine`, as a platform admin who also holds `org_owner`):

| action | target | managed | unmanaged | adds a person | sets or resets a local credential |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `sys_user.invite_user` | `organization/invite-member` | hidden | offered | yes, by invitation | the invitee sets a password at accept |
| `sys_member.invite_user` | `organization/invite-member` | hidden | offered | yes, by invitation | same |
| `sys_invitation.invite_user` | `organization/invite-member` | hidden | offered | yes, by invitation | same |
| `sys_organization.invite_user` | `organization/invite-member` | hidden | offered | yes, by invitation | same |
| `sys_user.create_user` | `admin/create-user` | hidden | offered | yes | yes (password) |
| `sys_user.set_user_password` | `admin/set-user-password` | hidden | offered | no | yes |
| `sys_invitation.copy_invitation_link` | script | hidden | offered | hands out the accept link | no |
| `sys_invitation.resend_invitation` | `organization/invite-member` | **offered** | offered | re-sends an invitation | no |
| `sys_member.add_member` | `organization/add-member` | offered | offered | no (an existing user joins an organization) | no |
| **`sys_user.add_sso_user`** (new) | `admin/add-sso-user` | **offered** | hidden | yes, pending | no |
| **`sys_user.import_sso_users`** (new) | `admin/import-sso-users` | **offered** | hidden | yes, pending | no |

The six doors of #25309 are the first six rows. The doors answer as the card says: `admin/add-sso-user` and `admin/import-sso-users` add a person on a managed boot and answer `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` off it (the live pins below drive both legs). `resend_invitation` is offered on a managed environment although its door refuses there; see Acceptance notes.

## Tests

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts`, a new top-level `describe` beside the six-door one. The real served predicates through `celEngine`, bound as the console binds them:
  - each new action targets its door and declares no `requiresFeature`;
  - offered to the platform admin when managed; hidden when the flag is off; hidden (`false`, not a fault) when no flag is served; hidden from an organization owner below the rung, even when managed;
  - on a managed environment the admin is offered exactly the two new actions and none of the six; off it, exactly the six and neither new one.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.test.ts`, a new top-level `describe` in the existing harness (a real `AuthManager` behind `AuthPlugin.registerAuthRoutes` on a real Hono app). Each leg reads the DECLARED action from `@objectstack/platform-objects/identity`, posts its dialog's body to its `target`:
  - `add_sso_user` on a managed boot answers `201`; the row reads `source = idp_pending`, no `sys_account`, the picked position and permission set, and the manager linked;
  - `import_sso_users` on a managed boot: a two-row CSV answers `200`, summary `{ total: 2, added: 2, alreadyPending: 0, failed: 0 }`, both rows `idp_pending`;
  - CONTROL: an unmanaged boot answers both targets `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` and adds no one.
- `platform-admin-affordance-standing.test.ts` now evaluates both managed modes: a member counts as offered to the platform admin when one mode offers it, and no refused principal may be offered a member in either mode. The two new actions join its family floor.
- `platform-objects.test.ts`: the byte rows for the two served predicates.
- `feature-gate-guard.test.ts`: the reverse walk (every `features.*` reference is booked) reads a new test-local `SHOWN_WHEN_ON` list for the two actions, and a new `describe` holds each to the inverse conjuncts `has(features.cloudManaged)` and `features.cloudManaged == true`, on a flag whose semantics are `hide-when-on`, and not booked the other way.

Runs at head `e6eb15eb`: `@objectstack/platform-objects` full suite 122 files, 1992 tests passed; `pending-sso-users.test.ts` 48 passed (3 new), run at `a199be81`; neither it nor `sys-user.object.ts` changed after, and the three new legs passed again on the restored tree after A5.

## Acceptance notes

- **No spec change, so the feature-gate registry does not book the two actions.** `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES.cloudManaged` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`) books inputs under one predicate, `features.cloudManaged != true`, and `feature-gate-guard.test.ts` holds every booked input to it, so an input the flag SHOWS cannot be booked there without a new registry member. The order rules out a spec change, and the registry has no runtime reader (only this guard), so the two inputs are listed in a test-local `SHOWN_WHEN_ON` beside the reverse walk, and pinned. The question whether the registry should model that polarity is in the report.
- **`sys_invitation.resend_invitation` is offered on a managed environment, and its door refuses there.** Measured in the table: its predicate has no `cloudManaged` term, and `organization/invite-member` answers `409` on a managed environment, resends included (`auth-manager-before-hook.ts`). It is not an add-person action and this PR leaves its predicate as it is; reported for the seat.
- **`ban_user` / `unban_user` keep `requiresFeature: 'admin'`.** #33227 made both doors work without the admin plugin, and its hand-over names this card for dropping that gate. The order scopes this card to adding people and does not name it, so it is left alone and raised in the report.
- **Neither new action is exposed to AI agents**: no `ai` block. ADR-0011's identity-actions note lists the actions assessed so far; these two postdate it and are human-only until assessed, as `list_platform_admins` is.
- The resultDialog of `import_sso_users` shows the per-row answer as JSON. The row-by-row UI, re-send and the status display are #33187.
- Clause-② widening, what it widens: two new published `sys_user` actions and their `en` plus ten translated locale keys (`add_sso_user.*`, `import_sso_users.*`). Nothing previously offered is hidden.
